name: Holy Cross Anglican Church

sources.label: ChurchFinder listing: Holy Cross Anglican Church, Tucson AZ

notes: Small Anglican congregation on N Country Club Rd. Only a directory listing was confirmed; the listing was inconsistent about whether it is Episcopal or a continuing-Anglican body, so the jurisdiction needs checking. No website, pastor or sermon archive found. Third of three 'Holy Cross' churches in Tucson - keep separate from the Lutheran and Presbyterian ones.
